purpose: This table holds cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations for the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January to June 2013, feeding downstream joins to flight data by origin and time.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (the declared grain) to attach weather context to flight records; consumers should expect and handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming full coverage.
limitations: wind_gust is missing for 74.6% of rows and pressure for 11.5%, so any aggregate or join relying on those columns will silently lose coverage; wind_dir and wind_speed carry small null rates (1.68% and 0.015% respectively) that are retained rather than imputed; year, month, and day/hour fields were cast from DECIMAL to INTEGER based on observed whole-number ranges rather than an explicit schema guarantee.
